reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` has now label `return_code` to specify the http code of the request", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Monitoring systems scraping the `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` metric will receive an additional `return_code` label on each metric series, which may require updating metric queries and dashboards.

proposed.statement: The `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` metric now includes a `return_code` label to specify the HTTP code of the request.
